slides.lead: One of the reasons my app got rejected. Here's what it needs.
If users can sign up in the app, they need to be able to delete their account in the app too.
Settings → Account → Delete account. A reviewer should find it in seconds.
"Disable my account" isn't the same thing. Remove the account and its data.
Sending people to email or a website as the only way usually won't pass.
One confirmation step, plain words about what gets deleted. No guilt trips.
Give a demo account and the exact path to the delete button.

slides.h2: Build it before you submit. Not after the rejection.
